    We are a professional manufacturer and trading company specializing in paper and plastic packaging products, integrating production, sales and foreign trade services. At present, we have nearly 100 types of products in stock, with more than 10,000 pieces in stock for each model, ensuring fast delivery and stable supply for global customers. We adhere to strict production standards to provide reliable, safe and practical packaging solutions, with stable quality and cost-effective prices that are widely recognized by overseas buyers.
